note: Small RV park in an open grass field behind the Rosebud Casino fuel plaza on US-83, just north of the Nebraska line in South Dakota (Rosebud Reservation), north of Valentine. Spots with pedestals along a gravel track; nearest dump station in Valentine. Real RV sites, not a casino parking lot. --Claude
summary: Operator page read today: 10 water + 30/50 A spots, $35 + tax, pay at the Fuel Plaza, free WiFi, no dump, stays over 3 days need approval. Hookups, sites, facilities, fees and booking (max stay + note) now manual. Season left derived (page silent). The park is in South Dakota (Todd County), not Nebraska. Private gate passes on price ($35) and presence (operator page + phone); Google shows only the casino (3.8 from 864); RV Life 7.75 from 8.
flags: STATE WRONG: the RV spots (~43.0013,-100.5761), the casino and the stored pin all fall in Todd County, South Dakota on TIGERweb; the state line here is the east-west road ~150 m south of the casino (~42.9985). Entry state should be SD, not NE (Google's 'Valentine, NE 69201' is a mailing address).

PRIVATE GATE: price $35 + tax (operator page, live 2026-11-05; the page carries no date of its own, earlier read 2026-10-16) - under $50. Presence: operator page with phone (800) 786-7673 (stored, matches). Good Sam: not checked as a GS Park claim (none stated). Long-stay tests: an overnight stop ('10 RV spots for overnight parking', stays over 3 days need approval), no residents, no monthly rates - passes all five.

RATINGS: Google has no separate RV-park listing; the query lands on 'Rosebud Casino' itself, 3.8 from 864 reviews (a casino rating, not the RV park's - AWH to judge whether it counts). RV Life 7.75/10 from 8 ratings (under 25, decides nothing). RV Life reviews quoted: 7/2024 motorhome [8]: 'Large open field behind the gas station by 40 yards. Quiet and reasonably level. No problem in a 42ft RV pulling a Jeep JKU.'; 7/2023 [6]: 'there was no water ... they dont take reservations'; 7/2017 [2]: 'No light at all in the vicinity. No signage'.
INCLUSION OK: designated spots with water/electric pedestals in a field west of the fuel plaza (pedestals visible on NAIP along a gravel track), not a casino-lot allowance.
PIN (~215 m, optional move): stored 43.00016,-100.57384 is at the US-83 entrance by the fuel plaza; the spots centre at about 43.0013,-100.5761.
BOOKING: the page says nothing about reservations; a 2023 RV Life reviewer says 'they dont take reservations'. reservable/fcfs not written.
PHONE: stored 800-786-7673 is the casino line; the page also lists 'Plaza 83 Phone: (605)-653-3456', the fuel plaza where spots are assigned - a better campground contact if AWH wants it.
